versions.subject: Detects change location evtx used wecutil
versions.detection:
selection_cmd:
    Image|endswith: \wevtutil.exe
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - wevtutil
        - /lfn
        - \.evtx
filter_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - \Windows\System32\winevt\Logs
condition: selection_cmd and not filter_cmd
